name: Med spa

pf.license.need: always: each prescriber (a physician, nurse practitioner or physician assistant) and each nurse injector holds their own active license from the state where the client is during the visit, video exams included
pf.license.who: each person; the med spa too, where the state's form registers medical spas or asks for a medical director on file
pf.license.ask: each person's license number in their invite reply (or the owner sends it); the medical director's name and license; any laser or facility registration the state's form names
pf.license.check: none: Rosie never looks up, checks or confirms a license, insurance or registration (D96); anything shown is as given by the business, not checked by Rosie
pf.license.blocks: nothing waits on a license (D96): the business and each person go live once set up and the owner says yes; a job the owner says needs a license they don't have isn't booked
pf.license.scope: who may examine, prescribe, inject or run a laser, and under whose order or supervision, is each state's own rule, from the state's form (a switch); Rosie offers each person only for the services that switch allows, and never books work beyond a license
pf.license.video: a good-faith exam by video only where the state's form allows it, and only with a prescriber licensed in the state where the client is that day
pf.license.away: injections at a client's home only where the state's form allows treatment away from the med spa (a switch), after the prescriber's exam, with the medical director's OK for each visit
pf.license.agreement: a health privacy agreement (a HIPAA business associate agreement) signed on the secure page before the first booking
pf.license.renewals: optional reminders the owner sets; a license the owner says has lapsed pauses that person's new bookings for that work (the owner's word, never a check)
pf.license.insurance: malpractice insurance for each prescriber and injector, where the state's form asks for it

pf.services.shape: treatments priced by the session from the list, or set at the visit by the amount used (units of a wrinkle relaxer, syringes of filler); a new client's first injection or laser visit starts with a prescriber's exam, right before the treatment or by video the day before
pf.services.examples: the example med spas' own prices (Lee Med Spa and Lee Mobile Aesthetics), not a standard

list.where: at the med spa; at the client's home through Lee Mobile Aesthetics

list.after: the rest at the front desk; at home, Rosie texts the bill, or the saved card is charged
list.note: the client sees the units and the price on the secure page, and says yes before any injection

list.after: the rest at the front desk

list.before: a card saved for the $20 fee

list.after: charged to the saved card each month

pf.services.capacity: one client per injector at a time; a treatment room for each; the laser room for laser sessions
pf.services.nobodyHome: never: the client is always there
pf.services.online: the free consult and the good-faith exam by video, counted as at the med spa; a treatment is never done by video

beforeTimes: new or returning client (a new client's first injection or laser visit adds the 15-minute exam)
which treatment, by its general name only
for laser: which area, since it sets the length
for a video exam: the state the client will be in
afterTime: anything that helps at the visit, like a step-free door or an interpreter
at home: a private room with a table, a clean surface and good light
securePage: the screening the medical director set: like blood thinners, a nerve or muscle condition, an infection at the area, a past bad reaction to the product, a recent tan or acne medicine before laser
a recent treatment: a wrinkle relaxer in the last 3 months, or filler or laser on the same area in the last 2 weeks
photo consent: for the chart only, or for ads too (a separate yes)
pf.questions.whoMayBook: an adult 18 or older, for themselves; another adult may book and pay for them, but the client fills in and signs their own forms; nobody under 18 is booked for injections or laser through Rosie
pf.questions.screening: any yes to the screening pauses the booking: the prescriber reads the answers on the secure page first and says OK, no, or asks one question; a no is told kindly, never why
pf.questions.neverAsked: health details, medicine names and photos are never asked or typed in the AI chat or a text

stop.words: vision changes or loss, or skin turning white, gray or blue, after a filler
stop.say: Call 911 now, or the medical director's line right away: (555) 010-0190. Don't wait.
stop.booking: no booking; the medical director is told at once

stop.words: trouble breathing or swallowing, or swelling of the face, lips, tongue or throat
stop.booking: no booking; the medical director is told at once

stop.words: weakness that spreads, a drooping face, or trouble speaking after a wrinkle relaxer
stop.say: Call 911 now, or the medical director's line right away: (555) 010-0190.
stop.booking: no booking; the medical director is told at once

stop.words: chest pain, fainting, or a burn after laser that is large, blistering or spreading
stop.say: Call 911 now. Then call the medical director's line.

goOn.words: a heavy eyelid, a lump, or more bruising or swelling than expected, days after a treatment
goOn.what: the 911 words first; then a nurse calls the client today on the medical director's line; Rosie gives no advice

goOn.words: pregnant, nursing, a medicine or a condition, said while asking to book
goOn.what: not typed in the chat: the AI says the screening is on the secure page, and the prescriber reads it before anything is booked

pf.safety.always: the general screen: danger to life, fire, gas or a medical emergency gets 911, and words about self-harm get 988
pf.safety.medicalDirector: the medical director's line, (555) 010-0190 at the example med spa, answered day and night; told at once about any warning sign after a treatment

steps.name: The good-faith exam by a prescriber
steps.when: before a client's first injection or prescription treatment: right before it, in person, or by video the day before where the state allows
steps.who: a physician, nurse practitioner or physician assistant licensed where the client is
steps.goodFor: 12 months, or until health or medicines change (the example med spa's rule; the state's form may set less)
steps.result: cleared, with an order the injector follows; or not today: no treatment, the deposit refunded in full, and the reason given in person, never by text

steps.name: Health history, screening and consent
steps.when: on the secure page only, before the booking is written; updated at each visit
steps.result: any yes to the screening: the prescriber reads it first (OK, no, or one question)

steps.name: Before photos
steps.when: at the visit, before any treatment, with the client's consent
steps.result: kept in the med spa's chart only, never in a text or the AI chat

steps.name: A written price estimate for self-pay clients
steps.when: told while booking, where the rules require it; sent within 1 business day (the example med spa's rule)
steps.who: every client: all treatments are self-pay
steps.result: a to-do for the front desk, with its due date

steps.name: The medical director's OK for a home visit
steps.when: before any treatment at a client's home
steps.who: Sam, as medical director, for each request
steps.result: OK, another time, or no; a home visit is never booked without it

pf.first_steps.prep: the med spa's own prep notes, on the secure page (like arriving with a clean face, or a shaved area for laser); bring a photo ID; new clients arrive 10 minutes early

pf.visit.checkIn: at the med spa: the check-in code at the front desk; a video exam: the code read out at the start; at home: the code given at the door to the injector
pf.visit.beforeWork: a new client's exam by the prescriber; the consent and screening checked; before photos for the chart, with consent
pf.visit.changes: units or syringes are set at the visit within the prescriber's order; the client sees the price on the secure page and says yes before any injection; more later only with a new yes
pf.visit.done: the check-in code or DONE; the treatment record (the product, its lot number, the units, the areas, the injector) goes in the med spa's chart, never in a text
pf.visit.aftercare: aftercare in person and on paper, and on the secure page, with the warning signs and the medical director's line
pf.visit.followUp: the free 2-week check, booked by the injector at checkout; any touch-up there is the injector's call
pf.visit.away: at home: only after the prescriber's exam and Sam's OK; a private room with a table, a clean surface and good light; the injector brings the med spa's emergency kit

pf.money.before: wrinkle relaxers and filler: a $25 exam fee taken as the deposit, counted toward the price; refunded in full if the prescriber doesn't clear the client; after a no to the price at the visit, it pays for the exam; laser and microneedling: a card saved for the $20 fee; the free consult and the 2-week check: nothing taken; a laser package: paid in full when booking; at home: the $89 house-call fee paid as the deposit
pf.money.after: at the med spa: the rest at the front desk, its own way; at home: Rosie texts the bill when the injector texts DONE with the units, or charges the saved card, after the client's yes to the price
pf.money.fees: the late-cancel or no-show fee: $20 at the example med spa (on injections, the $25 deposit; at home, the $89 house call), only when the owner confirms it; free to cancel until 24 hours before
pf.money.packages: packs of sessions are paid in full, and each visit uses a credit; a late cancel or a no-show may use up a credit, only when the owner confirms it
pf.money.membership: a monthly membership, $99 at the example med spa, charged to the saved card each month only after its own yes; texted the day before each charge; pause or end by text
pf.money.selfPay: every treatment is self-pay: no health plan is billed; a client is told while booking that they can get a written price estimate, where the rules require it
pf.money.rosfield: the $2 per booking applies to this work, as to every kind of work (D97): a flat fee for each booking Rosie's AI makes, shown at sign-up for the owner's yes; a booking the business puts in itself carries no $2; card payments cost only Stripe's own card fee, paid to Stripe
pf.money.caps: deposit cap: from the state form; any limit on fees for medical care: from the state form
pf.money.tax: a tax line on cosmetic treatments only where the state taxes them (a switch from the state form)

pf.messages.never: texts carry only the med spa's name, the date, the time, the address, the provider's first name and a secure link: never the treatment, units, the reason, health details, medicine names, photos or results
pf.messages.staff: texts to the owner and staff use the client's initials, with no health detail, medicine name or photo: only 'an update on the secure page'
pf.messages.photos: before and after photos stay in the med spa's chart, never in a text or the AI chat; a client sees theirs at the next visit or asks the front desk
pf.messages.channels: a client who says texts aren't safe is reached only the way they pick
pf.messages.minors: nobody under 18 is booked, so no treatment texts go to a minor

pf.staff.licenses: each prescriber's and injector's own license, per state; the medical director's license on file
pf.staff.skills: the medical director (a physician): exams, orders, every treatment; nurse practitioners: exams, orders and injections where the state allows; nurse injectors: injections and laser on a prescriber's order, where the state allows; estheticians: skin care only, and microneedling only where the state's form allows; medical assistants and the front desk: no clinical work or OKs
pf.staff.supervision: a nurse injects only on a prescriber's order, with the medical director or a supervising prescriber on site or reachable, as the state's form sets (a switch); a physician assistant works with a supervising physician as the state sets
pf.staff.oks: the owner, as medical director, OKs fees and each home visit; prices come from the list or are set at the visit within the order, so no quote waits for him
pf.staff.standIn: another listed injector who may do that treatment, only with the client's yes; with no yes, nobody is moved: the time stays, and the desk calls
pf.staff.away: home visits: only injectors cleared for work away from the med spa, licensed where the client is
pf.staff.never: Rosie never offers anyone for work beyond their license or the state's switch

pf.rules.records: the treatment record and photos are kept by the med spa as long as the state's rules require; a delete request removes only Rosie's own booking details
pf.rules.consent: a signed consent before any injection or laser, on the secure page
pf.rules.photos: a separate yes before any photo is used in ads
pf.rules.estimate: the written price estimate for self-pay clients, where the rules require it
pf.rules.telehealth: a video exam follows the rules of the state the client is in
pf.rules.away: treatment at home only where the state's form allows it, with the medical director's OK
pf.rules.age: nobody under 18 is booked for injections or laser through Rosie; the med spa's desk handles any question from a parent
pf.rules.ads: no claims about results the state's rules don't allow
pf.rules.privacy: health privacy rules for every message and form

pf.edges.lateArrival: up to 15 minutes late: still seen, in the time left; later: the desk moves the visit, since the exam and the treatment are back to back (Rosie never changes the booking itself)
pf.edges.screening: a yes on the screening: the prescriber reads it before anything is booked; a no is told kindly, never why
pf.edges.notCleared: the prescriber doesn't clear the client: no treatment, the deposit refunded in full, the reason given in person
pf.edges.reaction: warning signs after a treatment: 911 or the medical director's line first; then a nurse calls; Rosie gives no advice
pf.edges.photos: a client asks for photos by text: never sent; seen at the next visit or from the front desk
pf.edges.question: a health question by text: the clinical team answers on the secure page; Rosie gives no advice
pf.edges.standIn: an injector out: another listed injector, only with the client's yes; or new times with no fee
pf.edges.minors: under 18: no booking; the desk talks with a parent
pf.edges.credits: a late cancel or a no-show on a package or membership may use up a credit, only when the owner confirms it
pf.edges.twoBookings: a client with two open bookings: Rosie asks which one before any change
pf.edges.video: out of state that day: the exam in person, or by video on a day they're back
